text: This is tripwire, a stop-loss for your Mon: if the price falls, it sells for you.
cap: tripwire is a stop-loss for your MON: if the price falls, it sells for you.

text: My Mon stays in my wallet. A bot sells it only on my terms, and the chain refuses anything else.
cap: My MON stays in my wallet. A bot sells it only on my terms, and the chain refuses anything else.

text: Other stop-loss bots can sell however they like once you grant them. This one cannot.
cap: Other stop-loss bots can sell however they like once you grant them. This one cannot.

text: This is live on the real Monad network, with real money, kept small.
cap: Live on Monad mainnet. Real money, kept small.

text: A stop sells when the price falls to a line I choose. The price is the pool's average over sixty seconds, so one spike cannot trip it.
cap: A stop sells when the price falls to a line I choose. The price is the pool's 60 second average, so one spike cannot trip it.

text: Row one sells zero point three Mon. I set its line above today's price, only so you can watch it sell. A real stop sits below.
cap: Row 1 sells 0.3 MON. Its line, 0.02479, sits above today's price of 0.02430, only so you can watch it sell. A real stop sits below.

text: Every row has a floor, the lowest price it may sell at. Row two, zero point two Mon, sits ten percent below, so it should never sell.
cap: Every row has a floor: the lowest price it may sell at. Row 2, 0.2 MON, line 0.02187, sits 10% below, so it should never sell.

text: Now a wallet. A pass key is the wallet. It opens with my fingerprint, with no extension and no seed phrase.
cap: A passkey is the wallet. It opens with my fingerprint: no extension, no seed phrase.

text: I put one Mon into it.
cap: I put 1 MON into it.

text: One pass key prompt signs the plan, and the signed plan goes to Monad.
cap: One passkey prompt signs the plan, and the signed plan goes to Monad.

text: Now the keeper, the bot that sells for me, is watching. Row one's line is already crossed.
cap: The keeper is the bot that sells for me. Row 1's line is already crossed.

text: It sells exactly zero point three Mon, once, and the money lands in my own wallet.
cap: It sells exactly 0.3 MON, once, for 0.007267 USDC, and the money lands in my own wallet.

text: Here is that sale on the explorer. Status success.
cap: The sale on the explorer: status success.

text: Read straight from the chain: the money from the sale is there, and row two is still unsold.
cap: Read straight from the chain: 0.007267 USDC from the sale is in my wallet, and row 2 is still unsold.

text: Now the bad day: the keeper is hacked. This button makes the real keeper try a forbidden sale. A contract on Monad checks every one.
cap: The bad day: the keeper is hacked. This button makes the real keeper try a forbidden sale. A contract on Monad checks every one.

text: First, it sells before the price reaches my line.
cap: 1. Sell before the price reaches my line.

text: Second, it sells for half my floor.
cap: 2. Sell for half my floor.

text: Third, it pays the proceeds to itself.
cap: 3. Pay the proceeds to the keeper itself.

text: Each one failed, and that is the point. The chain refused it, said why, and paid out nothing.
cap: Each one failed, and that is the point. The chain refused it, said why, and paid out nothing.

text: Here is how. My plan carries a contract called the enforcer, which runs inside every sale on Monad. It checks the line, the floor, the amount, and who gets paid. The keeper holds none of my money.
cap: My plan carries a contract called the enforcer. It runs inside every sale on Monad and checks the line, the floor, the amount, and who gets paid. The keeper holds none of my money.

text: When I am done, I revoke the plan and take my unsold Mon back.
cap: Done: I revoke the plan and take my unsold MON back.

text: A stop-loss on your Mon that the bot can't break. tripwire, live on Monad.
cap: A stop-loss on your MON that the bot can't break. tripwire, live on Monad.
